Una vuelta con el dron de 26 segundos y,: A 26-second drone orbit and, without the images leaving the computer, the exterior of a house in 3D: textured scan, simple geometry. Open-source photogrammetry.
De un vuelo de dron a una casa en 3D: From a drone flight to a house in 3D
26 segundos de vídeo, 131 fotogramas, un: 26 seconds of video, 131 frames, a textured mesh and simple geometry to work with. All processed locally.
From a drone flight to a house in 3D.
Una vuelta con el dron de 26 segundos. C: A 26-second orbit with the drone. From that video, and without the images ever leaving the computer, comes the exterior of the house in 3D: the textured scan and simple geometry you can work with.
El proceso y el resultado, en 34 segundo: The process and the result, in 34 seconds
It is a house built from shipping containers. The video shows the flight, the intermediate steps and the viewer with both versions of the model.

Vuelo → 131 fotogramas → cámaras → malla: Flight → 131 frames → cameras → mesh and boundary → sections → viewer: exterior and geometry.
Cinco pasos, todos en un ordenador de ca: Five steps, all on a home computer, with open-source tools.
Del vídeo salen los fotogramas: Frames come out of the video
Un fotograma cada 0,2 segundos: 131 imág: One frame every 0.2 seconds: 131 images of the house from every angle of the orbit.
Cada cámara vuelve a su sitio: Every camera goes back to its place
El programa compara las imágenes entre s: The software matches the images against each other, places the 131 cameras back in space and builds a point cloud.
De la nube, una malla con textura: From the cloud, a textured mesh
Ocho millones de puntos se convierten en: Eight million points become a continuous surface with the real photographs on top.
A mano, sobre el modelo: lo que interesa: By hand, on the model: what matters stays and the rest is discarded.
Secciones a varias alturas dan el contor: Sections at several heights give the real outline. From there come the volumes and the roof, free of noise: the version you can compare with a plan, use to think about an extension or to count containers.
Lo que es y lo que no: What it is and what it is not
Se modela lo que la cámara ve desde fuer: Only what the camera sees from outside gets modelled. Porches and shaded areas come out worse.
Este modelo no está calibrado con medida: This model is not calibrated with field measurements. To measure, you need two or three passes at different heights and a tape measure.
Las imágenes se procesan en local con Op: The images are processed locally with OpenDroneMap. Photos of a home do not travel to someone else's server.
El resultado fino, con más fotos: A finer result, with more photos
Este modelo sale de un vídeo de 26 segun: This model comes from a 26-second video. A finer result takes more photos: several passes at different heights, original photographs instead of video and a reference measurement. That becomes a private job for whoever commissions it.
¿Una nave, una casa, una parcela?: A warehouse, a house, a plot?
Cuéntame qué quieres ver en 3D y para qu: Tell me what you want to see in 3D and what for. If construction-grade scale is needed, we plan for it from the flight itself.
